packageRules.description: One PR for all non-major Go module updates; majors stay on their own.
One PR for all workflow action updates, digest re-pins included. Automerged: the PR's own CI runs with the updated action, so a broken bump cannot go green.

One PR for the mise-managed toolchain. Automerged: dprint is exercised by test-integration, golangci-lint by lint, goreleaser by release-check. The rules below pull the risky pins back out of this group.

Devcontainer base image. Kept in its own PR and merged by hand: no CI job builds the devcontainer, and a branch only automerges when every update on it is automergeable, so folding this into dev tooling would silently make that group manual whenever both appear.
TinyGo compiles the plugin and mvdan.cc/sh is the formatter itself, so both get their own PR, a few days for the release to settle, and a manual merge.

Go toolchain, in .config/mise.toml and in go.mod. TinyGo 0.41.x rejects any GOROOT newer than Go 1.26, which fails build-wasm and test-integration. Drop allowedVersions in the same change that pins TinyGo 0.42.0 or later.
